Name: Better Forest Farm
Author: heyitsmads
Description:
[size=3]Better Forest Farm is a small set of thoughtful, optional adjustments to everyones favourite vanilla farm map, the Forest Farm. It's designed to be configurable and remain balanced, and is fully compatible with recolours and other mods.[/size]

[size=4][b]Forest Lake[/b] (optional)[/size]
[size=3]Replace most of ponds on the farm with a large lake that extends into the bottom right of the farm, with a small rustic jetty attached to it. Overall land cover doesn't change too much so as not to drastically change the vanilla balancing of the map, but it should be much easier to plan around and generally fits the foresty vibe.[/size]

[size=4][b]Secret Woods Shortcut[/b] (optional)[/size]
[size=3]Adds a shortcut straight from the bottom left of the map to the Secret Woods, because we're in a forest after all. The shortcut is behind a large hardwood log, same as the main entrance to the Secret Woods so progression doesn't change.[/size]

[size=4][b]Forest Fish Spawns[/b] (optional)[/size]
[size=3]Changes the default farm fishing spawn rates with those from Cindersnap Forest. This makes fishing on your farm more powerful than vanilla, but also feels more immersive (why is our lovely forest full of trash?)[/size]

[b][size=4]Remove shipping bin path [/size][/b][size=4] (optional)[/size]
Removes the dark dirt path to the shipping bin that all vanilla maps have, because why is Lewis hauling our stuff in a sack or something.

[size=4][b]Immersive Boundaries[/b][/size]
[size=3]A small tweak, removes the fences and lightly remodels the top [size=3]and [/size]right [/size]side[size=3] of the map, to make it feel more seamless and like you're nestled into an actual forest. Also adds a partially grassy shore to the small top pond,[/size]

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Replaces vanilla Forest Farm by default[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Compatible with all recolours, only vanilla tilesets are used (Vibrant Pastoral pictured in screenshots)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Should be compatible almost all other mods, except those that also alter the vanilla Forest Farm[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Known Issues[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Toggling the "Forest Lake" config option mid-playthrough can leave trees, debris, etc in the water of the vanilla pond / new lake. Either clear the areas before toggling the option, or enable no-clip mode (SMAPI/mod) to access stranded items[/size][/*]
[/list]
